description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between computational power, measured in TFLOPs on the x-axis, and loss ratio in percentage on the y-axis. The x-axis uses a custom scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8 TFLOPs, with tick marks labeled at intervals of 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis uses a linear scale ranging from 94% to 100%, marked at regular intervals of 1%. Five lines are depicted: the purple line with triangle markers and a solid style represents the 'Vanilla' method, which remains constant at 100% across the entire x-axis range. The orange line with line markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64)', starting at approximately 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rising to about 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs, peaking at 102% near 4e8 TFLOPs. The blue line with cross markers depicts 'SepLLM (n=128)', beginning at about 97% and ending at 99%, showing a steady increase. The green line with diamond markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64, H)', starting at approximately 97.5% and peaking at 101% before stabilizing at 99%. The red line with round markers shows 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)', starting at 94%, peaking at approximately 98% near 4e8 TFLOPs, and declining to 96% near the end of the x-axis. A legend is provided at the bottom right of the plot.
